publication_scope: sampling metadata only; not a benchmark score, Gold result, generated dataset, or executable question-instance set

selection_policy.selection_method: manual review of canonical question wording and each record's mapped PostgreSQL reference SQL
selection_policy.selection_criterion: Cover each declared semantic capability at least once while retaining independent examples of simple aggregation, cross-fact composition, semi-additive inventory, analytic windows, derived measures, entity-detail retrieval, nested queries, and multiple reference formulations.
non_goals: This selection does not modify canonical q01-q99 records.
This selection does not supply parameter values, Gold results, result rows, scores, or engine-specific models.
This selection is not an official TPC-DS query classification or an audited TPC benchmark workload.

provenance.reference_sql_resolution: Each row copies source_template, source_multi_statement, and reference_sql_files from the canonical record. The paths are evidence pointers, not target-visible context.

capabilities.aggregation: Aggregate functions, grouping, or aggregate predicates.
capabilities.temporal_logic: Date/time filtering, bucketing, or period comparison.
capabilities.relational_join: Multiple relational inputs joined through predicates or JOIN syntax.
capabilities.nested_query: A SELECT nested in another query block, including CTE/derived-table/EXISTS forms.
capabilities.cross_fact: Two or more transactional TPC-DS fact tables are composed.
capabilities.semi_additive: Inventory snapshot quantities require explicit time semantics.
capabilities.analytic_window: An SQL OVER clause provides partition-relative or ranking logic.
capabilities.derived_metric: The mapped SQL derives a measure from arithmetic over base measures, for example a ratio, margin, delta, or net-of-return amount.
capabilities.entity_detail: The result returns business-entity identifiers or attributes at detail grain.
capabilities.multi_formulation: One canonical question maps to more than one reference SQL formulation.

questions.rationale_en: Customer-level returns above a store-average threshold; establishes the first reviewed qualification pilot.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 客户级退货高于门店平均阈值；也是首个已审查的 qualification pilot。

questions.rationale_en: Weekly web-plus-catalog comparison with day-level year-over-year ratios.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 按周比较 Web 与目录销售，并计算日粒度同比比率。

questions.rationale_en: Compact grouped sales-by-brand query; the basic aggregation and dimensional-join anchor.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 紧凑的按品牌销售聚合查询；作为基础聚合和维度连接锚点。

questions.rationale_en: Cross-channel sales/returns composition with net-loss and profit-derived measures.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 跨渠道销售/退货组合，并包含净损失和利润派生指标。

questions.rationale_en: Item revenue share uses a partitioned window denominator and returns item attributes.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 商品收入占比使用分区窗口分母，并返回商品属性。

questions.rationale_en: Two canonical reference formulations exercise equivalent multi-channel composition without choosing one as privileged.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 两条 canonical 参考表述用于等价的多渠道组合，不把其中任何一条视为优先表述。

questions.rationale_en: Inventory before/after comparison makes snapshot time semantics and a derived ratio explicit.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 库存前后对比显式覆盖快照时间语义及派生比率。

questions.rationale_en: Gross-margin rollup plus rank-within-parent couples derived measures, hierarchy, and a window function.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 毛利率 rollup 加父级内排名，组合派生指标、层级和窗口函数。

questions.rationale_en: The second multi-formulation case adds inventory detail, so formulation parity is tested under semi-additive semantics.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 第二个多表述案例加入库存明细，使表述等价性在半可加语义下得到覆盖。

questions.rationale_en: Cross-channel return and currency ratios with independent rankings stress derived metrics and windows.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 跨渠道退货和金额比率配合独立排名，覆盖派生指标和窗口压力点。

questions.rationale_en: Net sales and quantity differences combine three sales channels with their returns over adjacent years.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 净销售额和数量差异组合三类销售渠道及其退货，并比较相邻年份。

questions.rationale_en: Customer-detail retrieval keeps a non-aggregate entity lookup in the suite.
questions.rationale_zh_cn: 客户明细检索保证题集中包含非聚合的实体查找。
